hypotheses: Let $S\to S'$ be a morphism of schemes in a fixed big fppf site. Under the localization functor $j:(\Sch/S)_{fppf}\to(\Sch/S')_{fppf}$, Construction A (Stacks, Stacks and localization) regards a stack $\mathcal X\to(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$ as the same category fibred over $(\Sch/S')_{fppf}$ by composing its structural functor with $j$, together with its canonical morphism to $(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$. Conversely, Construction B regards a stack $\mathcal X'$ over $S'$ equipped with a map $\mathcal X'\to(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$ over $S'$ as a stack over $S$. These are mutually inverse 2-functors.
